name: Junzhao Yang
metaDescription: Academic homepage of Junzhao Yang, a researcher in theoretical computer science.
introduction: I am a third-year Ph.D. student in the [Computer Science Department](https://www.csd.cs.cmu.edu/) at Carnegie Mellon University, where I am fortunate to be advised by [Richard Peng](https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~yangp/). Previously, I graduated from the [Yao Class](https://iiis.tsinghua.edu.cn/info/1109/4176.htm) at Tsinghua University.

My research interests broadly lie in theoretical computer science. More specifically, I am interested in the design and analysis of fast and space-efficient algorithms, including problems in numerical linear algebra and optimization.
authorOrderNote: Authors are listed alphabetically, as is customary in theoretical computer science.
